# Vonage API outage history — every incident their status page has posted

**53 Vonage API incidents on record** spanning **2026-07-22** to **2026-09-04**. Status page:
[https://vonageapi.statuspage.io](https://vonageapi.statuspage.io) · platform:
`statuspage` · last polled **2026-09-07 12:26 UTC**, last observed
state **`ok`**.

Median incident length: **3.0 h** across 49 incidents where Vonage API posted both a start and a resolve time.

This page republishes what Vonage API posted on its own status page. It is rebuilt
daily by an automated poller — no login, no account, MIT-licensed data.

## What is counted, and what is not

Of 53 recorded incidents, **49** have a usable length. Excluded:
3 maintenance, 1 still open or missing a timestamp, 0 whose resolution time we inferred rather than read, 0 with a resolve time before the start time. Those exclusions are the reason the numbers here are lower than a naive
count of the status page, and they are why a median from this dataset can be
compared across vendors at all.

"Incidents on record" means incidents this poller has seen or backfilled since
**2026-09-04** — it is not a claim about Vonage API's
entire operating history.
